{{Quote|The Mandalorian bastion is just beneath Mount Savage! Take the island, and turn the tide!|[[Dorjander Kace]] at the battle of Essien|<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic: War 1">[[Knights of the Old Republic: War 1|''Knights of the Old Republic: War'' 1]]</ref>}}
An '''island''' was located on the planet [[Essien]]. [[Mount Savage]] was located on top of the island.

In [[3962 BBY]], the [[Mandalorian bastion]] was established on the island. The bastion became the target for an assault by the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Galactic Republic Navy]] and the [[Phaeda Militia]] during the [[Essien landing]].
